finsetSum.statement: def finsetSum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → WeilConfig) : WeilConfig

finsetSum_productLemma.statement: theorem finsetSum_productLemma {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → WeilConfig) : h2_sign_cfg (finsetSum s f) ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, h2_sign_cfg (f i)

finsetSum_target_iff.statement: theorem finsetSum_target_iff {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → WeilConfig) : h2_sign_cfg (finsetSum s f) ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, (f i).target

finsetSum_rhs.statement: theorem finsetSum_rhs {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → WeilConfig) (k : ℝ → ℂ) : (finsetSum s f).rhs k = ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).rhs k

charCfg.statement: def charCfg (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) : WeilConfig

family_theorem.statement: theorem family_theorem : h2_sign_cfg (familyConfig q) ↔ ∀ χ ∈ family q, GRH_chi χ.primitiveCharacter

familyConfig_arith.statement: theorem familyConfig_arith (k : ℝ → ℂ) : (familyConfig q).rhs k = ∑ χ ∈ family q, (archTerm_chi χ.primitiveCharacter k - primeSum_chi χ.primitiveCharacter k)

family_three.statement: theorem family_three : h2_sign_cfg (familyConfig 3) ↔ ∀ χ ∈ family 3, GRH_chi χ.primitiveCharacter

family_three_statement.statement: theorem family_three_statement : FamilyTheorem 3 = (h2_sign_cfg (familyConfig 3) ↔ ∀ χ ∈ family 3, GRH_chi χ.primitiveCharacter)

zeta_rhs_pole.statement: theorem zeta_rhs_pole (k : ℝ → ℂ) : zetaWeilConfig.rhs k = poleTerm k - primeSum k + archTerm k

Product.sum_rhs.statement: theorem sum_rhs (C₁ C₂ : WeilConfig) (k : ℝ → ℂ) : (sum C₁ C₂).rhs k = C₁.rhs k + C₂.rhs k

Product.sum_target.statement: theorem sum_target (C₁ C₂ : WeilConfig) : (sum C₁ C₂).target ↔ C₁.target ∧ C₂.target
